name: Utility Workwear

intent_defaults.description: A practical workwear direction with task-specific storage, robust construction options and easy-to-service components.
intent_defaults.silhouette: Regular or relaxed, with movement and task clearance controlled by the wearer.

component_defaults.pockets: Task-specific pockets sized by user-declared objects
component_defaults.reinforcement: Optional reinforced panels where physically qualified

accessibility_defaults: All fit, closure, coverage and material choices remain user-editable.
circularity_defaults: Offer repair, alteration and modular-replacement options where compatible with the wearer intent.
caveats: This preset is not protective equipment and makes no occupational safety claim.
Load capacity, abrasion resistance, chemical resistance and protective performance require appropriate testing.
